description: Accessibilité Voirie - Déplacement depuis les Arrêts de Bus - Communauté Urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The accessibility scheme identifies by section whether the road (walk, bus stop, crossing) is accessible to persons with reduced mobility, in accordance with the regulations in force. 3 levels of accessibility are determined to make a journey: accessible section, accessible with assistance or inaccessible to PRM. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Accessibility Roads - Travel from Bus Stops - Dunkirk Urban Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseaux de transport. The listing shows 2019-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
